preview: Hi, I recently turned 55 and I heard I can withdraw...
enquiry:
Hi, I recently turned 55 and I heard I can withdraw some of my CPF savings. How much can I take out and what do I need to do? Also, will this affect my retirement payouts later? Thanks.

(made up enquiry)
draftHtml:
Dear Resident,

Thank you for reaching out about your CPF withdrawal options at age 55.

When you turn 55, you may withdraw your CPF savings above the Full Retirement Sum (FRS), which is currently $205,800 for members turning 55 in 2026.CPF-001 (made up)

To make a withdrawal, you can submit a request through the CPF website or visit any CPF Service Centre with your NRIC.CPF-002

Your monthly retirement payouts under CPF LIFE will be based on the amount remaining in your Retirement Account.(verify)CPF-003

Warm regards,
ServiceSG
